proposed.explanation:
You asked whether Telecom Egypt's equity grew in 2025. The 2025 Total Equity figure (printed as 63,687,826 thousand EGP) is marked AMBIGUOUS because a stamp covers the 2025 column, so I cannot verify it and must not use it in any calculation. The only verified equity figure is the 2024 Reclassified Total Equity of 45,937,991,000 EGP. Therefore I cannot give you a confirmed yes/no answer on equity growth for 2025.

That said, the verified data that is available is strongly positive: net profit more than doubled from 10,111,328,000 EGP in 2024 to 22,578,063,000 EGP in 2025, and total assets grew from 197,952,788,000 EGP to 225,882,527,000 EGP. These verified figures suggest the balance sheet is expanding and profitability is accelerating, which is consistent with equity growth, but the equity line itself remains unconfirmed.

Given your stated goal of keeping a solid telecom holding over a 5-year horizon, your low willingness to accept losses, and the fact that you already own 300 shares of ETEL, the most appropriate action is to hold your existing position. The verified profit and asset growth support the thesis, and your 5-year horizon gives the company time to deliver. I would not add to the position right now because (a) the 2025 equity figure is unverified, (b) ETEL already represents roughly 81% of your total portfolio value (42,585 EGP in shares out of 52,585 EGP total), and buying more would push a single stock well past the 50% diversification cap, and (c) your low loss tolerance argues against increasing concentration. Revisit the position once the 2025 equity figure is confirmed in a clean filing or the next annual report.
